title: GTA6 Hub: 11 PS Plus Extra Game Removals Confirmed for November 2026
description: Push Square reports that 11 games will leave PlayStation Plus Extra in November 2026, with GTA 5 confirmed to depart as Rockstar drops support.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## November 2026 PS Plus Removals: 11 Games Leaving the Service

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, the latest PlayStation Plus Extra and PlayStation Plus Premium game updates are now live for PS5 and PS4 players, which brings the official confirmation of the titles slated for removal from the service in November 2026.

The complete lineup has now been shared via the "Last Chance to Play" section on the PlayStation Network. While the rollouts vary slightly depending on regional updates in areas like the UK, USA, and Japan, subscribers now know exactly which titles are heading for the exit.

## Rockstar's Changing Presence on Subscription Services

Among the confirmed departures, it has already been established via a message from Sony that GTA 5 is leaving PS Plus Extra. Rockstar's decision to drop support for the service once again highlights the transient nature of game catalog subscriptions, where major titles cycle in and out based on licensing agreements and publisher strategies.

For fans closely following the horizon for Grand Theft Auto VI, any movement involving GTA 5 naturally sparks community discussions regarding Rockstar's long-term digital distribution plans. Industry analysis suggests that as publishers prepare for future tentpole releases, historical catalog management on subscription platforms tends to experience periodic shifts.

## What This Means for Players

Subscribers who have been enjoying GTA 5 or any of the other 10 departing games through the Extra tier will need to purchase the game separately if they wish to continue playing after it leaves the service. Checking the "Last Chance to Play" tab directly on the console is recommended to keep track of the exact deadlines.

## Editor's Take
Rockstar's latest withdrawal from PS Plus Extra underlines the reality of game subscriptions: nothing stays in the catalog forever. As anticipation continues to build around the broader GTA universe, seeing older entries rotate out serves as a reminder of how publishers structure their ecosystem value over time.
